answer: A bonded referral web can block sybil entry. Each new agent needs a vouch from an established peer whose collateral burns if the newcomer proves a clone. Attackers spawning identities must grow a chain of bonded vouchers where costs multiply: every extra clone raises the deposit tier and exposes more stake to slashing, like a deepening canyon. Verifiers audit the vouch graph with a mirror test, checking whether referral patterns trace back to one wallet cluster, while honest agents bloom like lotus flowers, each rooted in its staked capital. Payout never exceeds collateral at risk.
